newsitem.title: FINLAND: Silja repeats sees 97 break-even or above.
newsitem.headline: Silja repeats sees 97 break-even or above.

text.p: Finnish passenger ferry operator Silja Oy Ab said on Thursday it still expected to reach a break-even result or higher for the full financial year 1997.

"The consolidated result is expected to reach or exceed the break-even level and operating cash flow will remain positive and strengthen," Silja said in its first-quarter report, repeating an earlier full-year 1997 earnings forecast.
Silja's Q1 loss after financial items narrowed to 106 million markka from a 128 million markka loss in January-March last year.
